sections.value: This blog is static and lightweight: no build step, no heavy JS. Content lives in JSON so you can filter by tags without a server.
Each post has: title, excerpt, date, reading time, author, and tags. The filter bar is built automatically from all tags in your posts (and projects).
To add images or video: in your post JSON, add a section with type "image" (url + optional alt) or "video" (url). They render with lazy loading for performance.
